historical_queue.scope: simple equal-count stale-body suspicion only; historical named scope, not 3821 or global closure

current_conclusions.finding: Placed/in-progress hair matches groom and body Arc identity; worker result is paired with the retained Arc. A different Arc with equal counts does not pass the match.
current_conclusions.limit: Does not establish that the Arc corresponds to the current model, runtime success, or global closure.

current_conclusions.finding: On a successful same-LOD corrective model reload with equal body cache key, the old Arc can be reused and hence hair matching that Arc can be reused or an old worker accepted.
current_conclusions.limit: Output difference, actual redraw, data/asset reach and product consequence are not proved; old hair can remain consistent with cached body. Existing q2327 and ledger 47; no new count or automatic alias.

current_conclusions.finding: A new distinct request replaces the prior worker handle; an unfinished older thread is detached and its result cannot be installed through that discarded handle. Several can coexist only if successive earlier workers have not finished.
current_conclusions.limit: No runtime, scheduling, supported frequency, resource harm, intended limit or independent accepted finding established.

current_conclusions.finding: BodyHead is constructed before request checks if the equal worker is already in progress.
current_conclusions.limit: Effect or performance significance not measured; no extra count.
